thread:
erin: Heads-up — started a v2 streaming-response shape change at 10:00PT (canary 10%). Observed truncated final chunk on tenant acme-prod. deploybot posted the rollout.

deploybot: [deploy] rolling v2/streaming-contract-change -> canary=10% (2026-03-21T10:00:00Z). To pause: `/deploy pause 6198765432`

james: Seeing reproducible error from legacy SDK 1.2.3: decoder fails with 'Unexpected end of stream' when final chunk missing.

maria: Repro'd locally with `curl --no-buffer`. v1 used a trailing empty chunk/CRLF, v2 optimization omitted it. Legacy decoders assume it.

carla: Ops suggestion — pin acme-prod to v1 until we have compatibility fix. Use `pin-tenant acme-prod v1` via deploybot.

devops_sam: Pin applied to acme-prod and acme-staging. Confirming: acme-prod -> v1, acme-staging -> v1. :white_check_mark:

james: Thanks. Can we cut a tiny v2 hotfix to reintroduce optional trailing chunk? That seems lowest-risk.

erin: Two paths: (A) patch v2 with trailing-chunk flag and resume canary, or (B) add proxy-level compatibility shim and widen canary. Which is faster?

maria: Patch ready in PR #879 — adds `--emit-trailing-chunk` toggle. All unit tests green locally. ETA ~45m to build + smoke. Will also add migration note.

carla: I'll lower the auto-pause threshold to 1 tenant while we roll to catch first failure. Currently auto-pause is 5 tenants.

devops_sam: Threshold set to 1. deploybot will auto-pause on first confirmed tenant error.

deploybot: [action] canary paused at 2026-03-21T10:07:12Z by auto-threshold. reason: "stream-truncation" observed (tenant: acme-prod).

james: Full rollback of v2 is heavier; prefer hotfix + resume. Maria, coordinate patch release + release notes + short migration blurb for SDKs.

maria: On it. I'll publish a short notice in #release-notes: "v2 streaming: clients should accept optional empty final chunk; v2 patch will reintroduce it for compatibility." Also will tag SDK maintainers.

erin: @ops-eyes can you add a monitor for streaming decode errors across tenants for 24h? We want fast detection post-resume.

ops-eyes: Monitor added: `streaming.decoder.errors > 0` alerting eng-oncall for 24h window.

carla: Post-fix plan: unpin acme-prod, resume canary at 5% then 20% after 30m if no alerts. Documented in runbook.

devops_sam: Current pin list: [acme-prod, acme-staging]. Runbook link: https://go/redwood/runbooks/streaming-compat

erin: Good. I'll update the release notes before unpin and close thread once patch is live. :thumbsup:
